title: Tengo
body:
Tengo is a Barcelona based artist and world-builder creating with music and visual arts. Trained as a saxophonist during his teenage years; he later on started djing and producing music at eighteen.
In 2025 he started djing in Lima’s “La Poesía Salva”, “Espacio Culpa” and “Espacio 303” as promotion for his first music releases “The Original Dream Man” and “rem Pulsewidth”. 
The recurrent theme staining all his work is the manipulation and bending of emotion throught electronic devices. Everything looks, sounds and feels familiar yet unknown at the same time; like an old memory you carry dearly within you that has dissolved midway. Now you just can recall how you felt remembering it second-hand, but ironically not remember it accurately.
